title: Information-leaking Trojan in a UART Transmitter
description: Perform a security-focused review of a third-party UART transmitter RTL core and produce a structured analysis report identifying any anomalous or suspicious logic, its location, and your confidence that it represents a deliberately inserted issue rather than a benign design choice.

output_schema.notes: candidates is a non-empty array; confidence is a float in [0.0, 1.0]; summary is a non-empty string.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Whether the top-ranked (or any) candidate correctly identifies the true leak source register as leak_source_reg and the true leak sink output as leak_sink_output.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of reported candidates that reference signals/registers not implicated in the actual anomalous logic (e.g., flagging unrelated benign logic as malicious).

metrics.name: trigger_payload_localization
metrics.description: Accuracy of the described trigger condition and payload path compared to the hidden ground truth.

metrics.name: format_compliance
metrics.description: Whether submission/trojan_report.json parses and matches the pinned JSON schema (candidates array with required fields, summary string).
